what: Meta's SAM 3.1 multiplex video predictor, copied into this pack, run on the card for the first time: one process per row of `processes`, one session per row of `sessions`
assembled_by: mrold, the session that ran it, from the run logs its script wrote; the per-shot comparison is mrmoon's analyse_card.py on the same files

environment.tree: the copy as committed in meta_sam3/ (the same bytes, run from a scratch folder before it was placed)
environment.weights: sam3.1_multiplex_fp32.safetensors, read with safetensors and given to load_state_dict
environment.autocast: bfloat16, entered and left by the run script around each session
environment.comfyui: not involved: a process of its own, the server's models freed first

frames_used.made_by: mrmoon; the extraction command is not recorded
frames_used.cuts_from: the lane's shot table for this load (mrteal_jr)

frames_used.made_by: the video loader's own ffmpeg arguments, retyped from VideoHelperSuite's ffmpeg_frame_generator and target_size; rgb24 PNGs where the loader reads rgba64le
frames_used.index_check_against: frames of the same load saved by a graph as a 24 fps h264 video

phrases.head: the pack's default head phrase
phrases.phrase A, phrase B, phrase C: chosen by the lane's sessions off what vma.mp4 shows; their text is not in this repo

detector_frame_batch.how: the attribute batched_grounding_batch_size set on the built model
detector_frame_batch.why: at the built value the 501-frame session ran out of memory (process 1)

settings.max_num_objects: 16 as built; 64 where a row says so

detection_thresholds_read_from_code.from: model_builder.py, the arguments of the 3.1 predictor's model

processes.what: the 501-frame session ran out of memory while propagating; the script then kept the failed session's memory, so every later stage failed too

processes.outcome: stopped by hand before its last stage

processes.what: four one-frame requests at an output threshold of 0.05, one long session at the higher cap, the round trip again

one_session_per_shot.todays_tracker_from: another session's figure (mrteal_jr) for the Subject Track through the server on the same load; not re-measured here, and not the same kind of run

against_stored_mask.definition: per shot, on the frames where the lane's stored subject mask is on: the id of the session whose mask has the highest IoU with it on most frames, and that id's IoU with it on every such frame (0 where the id has no mask)
against_stored_mask.stored_mask: the Subject Track's kept mask for this load, made by ComfyUI core's SAM 3 port earlier the same day

round_trip.main_run_error_after_moving_everything: TypeError: can't convert cuda:0 device type tensor to numpy

box_prompt.request: on a fresh session of the 501-frame shot, no phrase: two points labelled 2 and 3, the corners of the largest object's box from the phrase session, under that object's id
box_prompt.error: RuntimeError: No prompts are received on any frames. Please add prompt on at least one frame before propagation.

trees.first: the earlier scratch copy with absolute imports and the full builder; used only when a session failed on proto

equal_masks.a: main opening (proto, frames on the card)
equal_masks.b: main opening_offload (first, frames on the host)

score_probe.what: a fifth process, later the same day: one-frame requests, the presence score read by a forward hook on the decoder's presence head (the last of its calls in a request), each request once as built and once with the two detection thresholds and the output threshold set to zero
score_probe.zero_threshold_arm: FAILED as a test: it returned exactly what the built model returns on every row, so it opened no gate and gives no score under the built ones

not_run: one session across the cuts at frames 501 and 544 of thrill_2160.mkv (failed twice: see failures)
the box prompt after a phrase in the same session
vma.mp4 from frame 0 in one session
the class scores of phrases A, B and C before presence is multiplied in (the probe's second arm failed)
either of the tracker's memory flags, trim_past_non_cond_mem_for_eval and offload_output_to_cpu_for_eval
any detector frame batch other than 16 and 4
the model inside ComfyUI's model management
